social_media.headline: CME Analysis May Be Limited
social_media.summary: Energetic particles from the ongoing solar particle storm are degrading coronagraph imagery used to identify and analyze coronal mass ejections.

confidence.label: Status
confidence.detail: This data-quality limitation does not change the active hazard assessment.

what_we_know: Energetic particles are degrading coronagraph imagery used for CME analysis.
Confidence in expected CME arrival times, duration, and strength may be reduced.
SWPC continues its assessment using available imagery, models, solar wind observations, and forecaster analysis.
The active Space Weather Warning remains in effect.

footer.left: Forecast updates continue using available data.
footer.center: Next Warning Update by 0030 UTC Sunday.

visual.alt_text: SOHO LASCO C2 and C3 coronagraph imagery from May 11, 2024 showing energetic-particle streaking that degrades CME analysis.
